source: Moon: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/), public domain. Colour from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera wide-angle mosaic; elevation from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter gridded data, averaged from 16 to 8 pixels per degree. Built by tools/build-surface-maps.sh.
units: Paths are relative to the site root. Both maps are equirectangular with the north pole at the top and longitude 0 at the centre. Heights are raw little-endian signed 16-bit metres relative to reference_radius_m, height_width by height_height samples.
